sentences.text: * Thilakan as Pullattuparam Brahmadathan Namboothiripaddu (extended cameo appearance)
Mohanlal, though credited as a lead actor, has been noted to have only an extended cameo, the main role being that of Shobhana.
A spin-off titled Geethaanjali was released on 14 November, 2013, directed by Priyadarshan, with Mohanlal reprising his role as Sunny and Suresh Gopi as Nakulan in a cameo appearance.
